Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext

Class ToolbarContribution

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.ToolbarContribution
public final class ToolbarContribution extends Object
A toolbar button contributed by an extension. The button appears in the editor's toolbar under the extension's submenu when the extension is enabled and granted TextEditorPermission.TOOLBAR. When a contribution declares an accelerator, the editor also binds it as a keyboard shortcut so the action can be run directly, without opening the extensions card.

A contribution may also carry an optional Icon for the toolbar button art. It is supplied through the wider constructor; the pre-existing constructors leave it null, so every shipped and third-party extension keeps compiling unchanged. When no icon is present the editor falls back to a generated glyph, so a user-configured button always has art even off the test classpath where an icon store may be absent.

  • Constructor Details

    • ToolbarContribution

      public ToolbarContribution(String id, String label, String tooltip, Runnable action)
      Builds a contribution with no accelerator.
      Parameters:
      id - stable unique identifier within the extension (e.g. "sort-lines")
      label - button label shown in the UI
      tooltip - tooltip text (may be null)
      action - callback invoked on the EDT when the button is clicked

    • ToolbarContribution

      public ToolbarContribution(String id, String label, String tooltip, Runnable action, String accelerator)
      Builds a contribution that also carries a keyboard accelerator.
      Parameters:
      id - stable unique identifier within the extension
      label - button label shown in the UI
      tooltip - tooltip text (may be null)
      action - callback invoked on the EDT when the button is clicked
      accelerator - a KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(String) spec (e.g. "control alt S"); null/blank means none

    • ToolbarContribution

      public ToolbarContribution(String id, String label, String tooltip, Runnable action, String accelerator, Icon icon)
      Builds a contribution that also carries a keyboard accelerator and an optional button icon.
      Parameters:
      id - stable unique identifier within the extension
      label - button label shown in the UI
      tooltip - tooltip text (may be null)
      action - callback invoked on the EDT when the button is clicked
      accelerator - a KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(String) spec (e.g. "control alt S"); null/blank means none
      icon - button art (may be null; the editor then uses a glyph)
